task.description: WF-03 pre-close RELEASE-VALIDATOR gate for ISS-1042 (.claude/agents/release-validator.md). Independently re-derive each of the 4 acceptance criteria from files and your OWN runs; do not trust the TEST-RUNNER report. You write no code. Checks: (1) docs/issues/ISS-1042.yaml quotes the instrumented measurement; spot-check it against step-01 handoff and, if feasible, nothing more. (2) before/after: re-verify the 5+5 table is in the report with per-run ids; AND independently run ONE 'after' sample and ONE 'before' sample (MIX_TEST_PARTITION=1 mix test --partitions 12 --seed 0; before = throwaway worktree at cc65f7b16, after = branch head in another throwaway worktree; throwaway postgres port 5499, remove afterwards) and confirm the direction and rough magnitude (>=20% faster) of the claimed speedup; note the claimed 542 vs 527 test-count difference between arms and judge whether it undermines the comparison (e.g. compare time per test or the per-module times of the three adopter files, which are identical code in both arms). (3) isolation: confirm the pool test + mutant table; run test/letflow/support/tenant_fixture_pool_test.exs once yourself. (4) `git diff cc65f7b16..HEAD --stat` : confirm no change under .github/, no workflow/job name changes, no paid-runner labels, no lib/ or priv/ changes. Also check the diff for scope creep and that docs/anti-patterns.md entry exists. Record R4 (docs say 57 tables of a clone; a clone has 50 plain tables) as a known pending doc fix, not a blocker. Verdict PASS/FAIL in result.status, handoff status COMPLETED; list any findings with file:line. Foreground/polling only, no Monitors. Clean up worktrees/container. Commit the handoff and push (message ends with 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>').
